name: week
title: Customer data review
subtitle: Source freshness, identity conflicts and overdue work

sections.title: Source health
sections.sql: select code,owner,freshness,records,unlinked from source_health order by code

sections.title: Identity conflicts
sections.sql: select code,name,email_variants,name_variants from profile_conflicts where email_variants>1 or name_variants>1

sections.title: Overdue actions
sections.sql: select * from attention order by due_on

name: identity-review
title: Identity review queue
subtitle: Candidates require evidence before linking. A shared email is not proof of identity.

sections.title: Possible duplicates
sections.sql: select left_record,right_record,left_name,right_name,review_reason from duplicate_candidates order by left_record,right_record

sections.title: Privacy review
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by rule,reference
